correctness.rationale: For exact-arithmetic Euclidean FGMRES with 0<a,b<1, the established flexible residual projection identity yields R_j <= mu_j/sqrt(1-R_{j-1}^2). The continuant D_j=D_{j-1}-mu_j^2D_{j-2}, D_-1=D_0=1 gives gamma_j^2=mu_j^2 D_{j-2}/D_{j-1}. For the tridiagonal zero-diagonal offdiagonal a,b matrix, Perron strict finite-row bound ensures all D_j>0 when a+b<=1, and Rayleigh quotients establish a first failing minor when a+b>1. The explicit A=I invertible rank-one flexible preconditioners attain the bound at any finite nonterminal index and cause nonzero-residual breakdown at the first failing index. Elimination gives even-continuant recurrence and exact boundary closed form. Two-step restart gives sharp per-cycle factor ab/sqrt(1-a^2) for a^2+b^2<1 and a otherwise, always <1. Independent rational 2-periodic determinant tests verified selected choices. These are worst-case and exact-arithmetic claims only.
